title: Remote media purge or wipe needs approved scope and authorized test evidence
remediation: The deployment endpoint management authority documents assessed devices, triggering conditions, authorized roles and strong authentication for purge or wipe. Exercise the procedure on a disposable non-production device containing only synthetic data. Record scoped authorization, denial for an unauthorized role, execution status and independent confirmation of the expected result.

milestones.title: Collect approved device scope and trigger rules, redacted authorization and refusal results, and verified completion on a disposable test device
